name: Silk Perahera
blurb: Ivory silk drape, a fine gold mandala and a marching Kandyan perahera along the bottom.

name: Sage Lotus Silk
blurb: Pale sage silk with white lotus line art, a gold mandala crown and a sage perahera.

name: Velvet Seal
blurb: Emerald velvet with gold botanical line art, a velvet envelope and a gold wax seal.

name: Silk Letter
blurb: Dove-grey silk, a sage paper envelope and a gold wax seal pressed with a little tree.

name: Royal Curtain
blurb: Heavy crimson velvet curtains part to reveal an ivory and gold palace-style invitation.

name: Emerald Drape
blurb: Deep green satin drapes on a gold rod, names on the curtain and a glowing gold button.

name: Sakura Blush
blurb: Blush watercolor paper, cherry-blossom branches and a gold-ringed monogram — pretty and playful.

name: Rose Garden
blurb: Cream paper with a lush watercolor bouquet of roses, anemones and eucalyptus.

name: Blue Hydrangea
blurb: Soft cream paper framed by dusty-blue hydrangeas, navy italic names and a faded couple photo.

name: Ivory Lattice
blurb: Crisp ivory with a faint gold lattice, a fine gold frame and a slot for your couple illustration.

name: Poruwa Heritage
blurb: Maroon and temple gold with liyawel scrolls, oil lamps and a slow-turning lotus mandala.

name: Kandyan Royal
blurb: Deep oxblood velvet, a gilded pun kalasa and shimmering gold script behind a theatre-curtain reveal.

name: Nelum Lotus Pond
blurb: Soft blush and jade, a lotus blooming from rippling water, falling pink petals.

name: Araliya Garden
blurb: Fresh white and leaf green, swaying frangipani clusters, falling araliya blossoms.

name: Mangalam
blurb: Turmeric, kumkum red and brass — marigold thoranam, kuthuvilakku lamps, a turning kolam.

name: Kovil Emerald
blurb: Emerald and temple gold with a glowing gopuram outline and swaying jasmine strands.

name: Nikah Noor
blurb: Midnight teal with an arched mihrab frame, Bismillah calligraphy and hanging gold stars.

name: Rose Nikah
blurb: Dusty rose and ivory, geometric lattice and swinging glowing lanterns.

name: Holy Matrimony
blurb: Ivory and gilded gold, a cathedral arch with a radiant cross and doves in flight.

name: Rose Window
blurb: Deep cathedral navy with a slowly turning, glowing stained-glass rose window.

name: Golden Opulence
blurb: Black lacquer and liquid gold — Gatsby-style frames, a sunburst crest and falling gold leaf.

name: Midnight Champagne
blurb: Starry midnight navy with champagne foil, a turning monogram dial and twinkling stars.

name: Modern Minimal
blurb: Gallery-white editorial layout with oversized serif type, a clean grid and crisp reveals.

name: Coastal Vows
blurb: Sunset sand and ocean teal with rolling animated waves and palm silhouettes — made for Bentota and Galle.

name: Tea Country
blurb: Misty hill-country greens with layered tea terraces, arching leaf sprigs and drifting leaves.
